name: @dillydalli3r/omp-token-mega
description: One oh-my-pi plugin for the token economy: cache-safe reduction of live tool results, DeepSeek prefix-cache accounting with miss attribution, and the DeepSeek account balance and session spend. One command, one settings menu, one status row.
author: dillydalli3r

enabled.description: Master switch. false makes the whole plugin inert: no hooks, no counters, no shards, no network call, no status row.

statusRow.description: Draw the status row. Every metric this plugin tracks goes on that one line; turn it off to keep the numbers on demand only.

statusMaxChars.description: Maximum width of the status row. A segment that does not fit is dropped whole, never half-written.

statusSegments.description: Which groups the row shows, in order: cache, lithos, balance, token. Unknown names are ignored; an empty list hides the row.

stateDir.description: Directory holding the cache-accounting shards. Empty uses <agentDir>/omp-token-mega-stats.d.

token.enabled.description: Reduce tool results before they are first sent. Independent of the cache accounting and the balance poller.

token.preset.description: Named bundle of every other token.* knob, covering the extremes. Individual settings override it.

token.tools.description: Comma-separated tool names to reduce. `*` means every tool, `prefix*` matches a name prefix (`mcp__*` = all MCP tools), `-name` excludes.

token.minChars.description: Results below this size are left untouched: a marker is not worth a rewrite.

token.maxScanBytes.description: Hard ceiling on the text this plugin will scan. Larger results go straight to omp's own artifact spill. Bounds worst-case hook time.

token.squeeze.description: Strip terminal escapes, control characters and trailing whitespace; collapse blank-line runs.

token.fold.description: Collapse runs of identical consecutive lines into one line plus a count.

token.foldMinRun.description: Shortest run of identical lines worth folding.

token.clip.description: Per-line column cap for tools omp does not already cap. 0 disables. omp's own tools.outputMaxColumns default is 768.

token.json.description: Remove whitespace outside JSON string literals from payloads that parse as JSON. A string-aware strip, never a parse-and-reserialize, so numeric literals are preserved.

token.dedupe.description: Replace a result whose content is byte-identical to an earlier one in this session with a back-reference.

token.dedupeMinChars.description: Shortest result eligible for duplicate collapsing.

token.maxChars.description: Per-result budget. Above it the middle is elided behind an artifact:// handle. 0 defers to omp's tools.artifactSpillThreshold (50 KB).

token.headChars.description: Bytes kept from the start when a result is elided to its budget.

token.tailChars.description: Bytes kept from the end when a result is elided to its budget.

token.stash.description: Write removed text to a session artifact so artifact://<id> recovers it. The store omp's own spill uses.

token.minSavingsTokens.description: A rewrite must save this much on top of the marker it adds, or the original is sent untouched.

token.perf.description: Time the tool-result hook and report p50/max in the report, so the throughput cost is visible.

cache.enabled.description: Measure the DeepSeek prefix cache: accounting, miss attribution, drift notes. Active only while a DeepSeek model is loaded.

cache.subagents.description: Aggregate the shards this process's subagent sessions write.

cache.idleTtlMinutes.description: Idle gap after which a miss is attributed to the provider cache expiring (`idle_ttl`).

cache.retentionDays.description: Delete shards not written for this many days. 0 keeps them forever.

lithos.enabled.description: Register the LithosAI provider (models, /login, usage reporting), measure its speed and per-minute budgets, and draw its segment. Requires a restart to take effect when switched off.

lithos.baseUrl.description: LithosAI endpoint. Point it at a self-hosted Lithos Engine to use the same provider, login and metrics on-prem.

lithos.inputPerMillion.description: USD per million input tokens, from the console's rate card. 0 leaves cost unknown and the spend columns read $0.

lithos.outputPerMillion.description: USD per million output tokens. Cached input is a subset of input, not an addition to it.

lithos.cachedPerMillion.description: USD per million cached input tokens.

balance.enabled.description: Poll the DeepSeek account balance for the status row. Off means no balance request is ever made; session spend is unaffected.

balance.ttlSeconds.description: How long a fetched balance is reused before the poller refreshes it.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/status.js && node --check src/report.js && node --check src/menu.js && node --check src/token.js && node --check src/cache.js && node --check src/balance.js && node --check src/balance-client.js && node --check src/compress.js && node --check src/dedupe.js && node --check src/measure.js && node --check src/audit.js && node --check src/stats.js && node --check src/prefix.js && node --check src/deepseek.js && node --check src/repair.js && node --check src/usage.js
scripts.test: node test/token.test.mjs && node test/cache.test.mjs && node test/lithosai.test.mjs && node test/balance.test.mjs && node test/shell.test.mjs
